title: The Baobab: Upside-Down Tree of Tarangire
excerpt: Baobabs can live for many centuries. Why they look upside down and where to see them in Tanzania.
body:
## Upside-down tree

Without leaves in the dry season, the branches look like roots. Many legends explain this.

## Water storage

The trunk stores water, which helps it survive drought.

## Fruit

The fruit pulp is rich in vitamin C and used in drinks.

## Age

Some baobabs are estimated to be many centuries old.

## Elephants

Elephants sometimes strip the bark to get water.

## Where

[Tarangire](/blog/tarangire-national-park-guide/) and Ruaha are famous for baobabs.
